cold_init_ns.scope: current arm, Linux host, first response after collector entry
cold_init_ns.rationale: Rounded up from maximum 175853131 ns across 35 observations; pilot ceiling, not a percentile.

queued_interval_ns.scope: current arm, Linux host, adjacent queued response arrivals
queued_interval_ns.rationale: Rounded up from maximum 129549694 ns; includes observer scheduling and is not round-trip query latency.

query_latency_ns.rationale: Requests were queued together; queued intervals are a distinct observable.

instrumentation_overhead_ns.scope: same compiler and inputs with and without instrumentation
instrumentation_overhead_ns.rationale: Arms used different compiler revisions and stdlib trees.

peak_rss_bytes.rationale: Collector did not capture peak RSS.

context_usage.rationale: Host token accounting is available but is not context occupancy.
